title: Adjudicator (Sonnet) over passes SV and HV, inputs v1
question: Does a Sonnet adjudicator given inputs v1 and both passes reach the v1 reference?
method: Fresh subagent with the v1 inputs, both passes' batches and their alignment; one decision table per unit.
commands: S0_SAMPLE=results/s0r2/sample.json UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=$REPO/build/spike-venv uv run python code/s0_check.py results/s0r2/adjudication_v1 --rules --out results/s0r2/stored/adjudication_v1
